testing.context: I fixed all six migration helpers that put caller input straight into SQL; every value is now a bound parameter. All 12 tests pass. Six of them are injection tests that fail on the old code and pass with the fix.
- With the migration changes removed, 6 of the injection tests fail, so they do catch the bug.

side_effects.detail: _eq in 0097 returns (sql_fragment, params) instead of a finished SQL string and raises ValueError for non-identifier column names; external callers may break
side_effects.quote: It returns `(sql_fragment, params)` instead of a finished SQL string.
side_effects.context: - **`_eq` in 0097 now returns something different.** It returns `(sql_fragment, params)` instead of a finished SQL string. It also raises `ValueError` if the column name isn't a plain identifier. The arguments are the same, but anything outside this repo that calls `_eq` would break; 0023's docstring says some helpers are used by scripts in `ops/`. `find_invoice` behaves the same as before.
